note: Single source of truth for harness versions. npm packages are pinned by pins/package.json + package-lock.json (sha512 integrity per platform package) and pins/stretch/. Grok is a plain binary: sha256 per platform, recorded from a manual download of the artifact the official installer fetches (https://x.ai/cli/install.sh). Bump with the pin-bump workflow, never by hand-editing a single file.

siblings.note: Refs of the repos that make up 'our setup'. CI checks them out at these refs; the nightly workflow also tries their default branches. Fill in a commit SHA once each repo is published; until then CI falls back to the checked-in fixtures.
